asked.item: Freeze or pause plan for a few months

verdict.reason: The FAQ says there is no pause or freeze feature and gives the two options, keeping the subscription active or cancelling, with how credits are handled in each.

steps.text: Blotato does not have a pause or freeze feature.
Keep your subscription active to retain your credits, scheduled posts, and access.
Your other choice is to cancel from Settings > Billing > View Billing Portal.
For period-end cancellation, access and remaining credits continue until the paid period ends.
